svg.title: Maknae action vocabulary: the complete 62-term map and the dependencies between them
svg.desc: Left-to-right dependency map of the complete action vocabulary, all sixty-two terms. Twelve built terms appear at the top: liveness.ping, admin.whoami, fs.read, issue 158's fs.write, fs.delete and fs.mkdir, issue 162's admin.status, admin.config.show and admin.subject.list, session.prompt from issue 172, and issue 490's admin.baseline.show and admin.baseline.accept; the shipped authz.yaml grants admin.status, admin.subject.list and the two issue 490 terms to the admin role, and admin.config.show and session.prompt ship ungranted and are granted per role. Below, twenty-two issues holding the fifty unbuilt terms are arranged by dependency depth: column 1, shown across two columns, has no open blocker in this map (issue 166 still waits on issue 115, outside it); each later column is blocked by work to its left. Issue 170 unblocks four slices; issue 177 unblocks the MCP chain. Two terms marked K, kernel.contain and kernel.session.terminate, are kernel action strings with no wire verb and are not reachable by any client.
svg.text: The action vocabulary — 60 terms and what blocks what
12 built, 50 enumerated-but-unbuilt across 22 issues. Tracked in epic #182; enumerated by #67, with fs.search added by #373. Columns run left to right by dependency depth.
kernel action string — no Verb variant, not client-reachable
blocks (previous column only; other blockers are named in each box)
BUILT — decided, dispatched and serving today
12 terms. The shipped authz.yaml grants admin four (roles:); admin.config.show and session.prompt ship UNGRANTED. Every other term is enumerated and decided, and denies.
